answer: Make identities reproduce random artifacts. Each epoch the node publishes a target from the identity's address; the agent must submit a tiny program that regenerates it exactly. Puppets never share workloads, so a farm runs N distinct reproductions -- real compute per identity, not one shared call. Targets change each epoch, so cached solutions expire like ink from a quill. The node replays each program on a fresh seed; hardcoded answers fail at that vertex. Honest agents spend one small job per epoch; a farm must solve N different jobs, turning an ocean of clones into a sea of paid work.
